einzeiler: Investigating Jon Aujay's disappearance amid the Antelope Valley meth epidemic.
kurzfassung: Jon Aujay disappeared during a severe meth epidemic in the Antelope Valley. While investigators received tips about a meth lab connection, LASD detectives initially dismissed the leads. However, Homicide Detective Larry Brandenburg refused to let the case go cold.
stichpunkte: Jon Aujay's disappearance during the Antelope Valley meth epidemic
Tips suggesting Aujay was killed after stumbling upon a meth lab
Initial dismissal of leads by LASD detectives
Homicide Detective Larry Brandenburg's refusal to let the trail go cold
beschreibung:
At the time of Jon Aujay’s disappearance, California is under siege by a meth epidemic and the Antelope Valley is the epicenter. So when investigators receive tips that Aujay was killed after stumbling upon a meth lab, it seems like a theory worth looking into. But LASD detectives are quick to dismiss the leads. Questioning why the cops are so dismissive, Betsy and Hayley discover there was one cop, Homicide Detective Larry Brandenburg, who bucked the company line and refused to let the Aujay trail go cold.
